title: AI during the meeting, not after it
dek: Most notetakers hand you a summary once the call is over. Live help means four different things in 2026, from a transcript you can read to a note you did not ask for, and here is what each vendor ships.
description: What live meeting AI means in 2026: live transcripts, question boxes, rolling summaries and unprompted notes, vendor by vendor, plus the real latency.
og_headline: AI during the meeting, not after it
og_subtitle: Four tiers of live help, vendor by vendor, and why a note that lands in five seconds still counts.
